The brand 'ZEALOT' and model 'ZEALOT-S79' are printed on the front of the box.
The box displays features such as 'EXTRA SUPER BASS' and 'MULTI CONNECT FUNCTION'.
There is a watermark 'CHIBEN GADGETS' across the center of the image.
The background appears to be a retail or storage environment with other boxed goods.
